# fetch-kit

> Resilient HTTP client for Rust: retry, circuit breaker, connection pooling,
> and typed JSON helpers built on reqwest, with a native middleware stack that
> mirrors the `reqwest-middleware` shape.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): retry, breaker, and pooling semantics, feature flags, quick start.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-FK-001..901 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
